description: Opus LL V10 (staged serializer): a value set in one stage of the turn decides a later stage. Champions `formeChange` sets `moveThisTurnResult = true` on Mega Evolution ('Mega Evolution counts as an action for Truant'); the megaEvo action runs first, then Jolteon (Truant, faster) Entrains the Mega Gardevoir: Truant's onStart sees `activeTurns` 2 and `moveThisTurnResult !== undefined`, adds the `truant` volatile, and the Gardevoir loafs instead of using Moonblast. Two setup turns: Jolteon moves in the first and loafs in the second, so it can move in the decision turn.
